name: payload-required-on-update-after-create-without
hook: Making a field optional in Payload is a two-part fix: route AND schema
body: When fixing a Payload 'required field' validation error: the route fix (conditionally including the field) is necessary but not sufficient if the field is required:true in the schema. Even when a document is created without the field (key absent), subsequent UPDATE operations re-validate the full document against the schema and fail if a required field is missing. Always pair route fixes with schema changes to make the field optional.
why: The persist route fix conditionally excluded contextRef from conversationData when the doc didn't exist. But contextRef was required:true in the schema. The create succeeded (key absent), but the update (adding a message) failed Payload's required-field re-validation. Making contextRef required:false in the schema fixed it.
